tools.name: detect
tools.description: The agent apps this Mac has and whether each one's configuration already names Lilo's MCP server (installed, configured, stale).

tools.name: configure
tools.description: The MCP server entry Lilo needs in one agent app's configuration: the file or command, and the exact snippet or command to hand the user. It only produces the payload: nothing is written.

client.description: A harness id from detect, e.g. claudeCode, cursor

remove.description: Produce the removal command instead of the add payload
